pillars.d: 不必親臨現場，總部即可掌握每一個工地、廠區與建築的即時狀態。
跨城市、跨國家的多個據點，用同一套標準、同一個平台管理。
設備、能源、影像與工程資料即時串接，從監看走向預測與控制。
天（影像）、地（感測）、腦（AI）、中樞（VBIM），一眼看懂整棟建築。
從全球、據點、建築、樓層、空間到設備，一個畫面掌握全局。
文件、圖面與施工影像上鏈留痕；AI 代理依授權行事，可追溯、可撤銷。

stages.d: 智慧清圖、錯誤排查、模型協作、版本與設計審查
進度、品質、工安、材料、影像與施工模型同步
缺失、複驗、設備點交、竣工圖與線上簽核
設備、維保、VMS、AIoT、能源與 ESG 即時管理
保固、公設、修繕、管委會與完整建築履歷

edge.d: BIM + PMIS + CCTV/VMS + AI + AIoT + 數位孿生，不再讓資料散落在不同工具。
線上簽署、完整稽核軌跡與上鏈留痕，降低工程爭議與資訊失真。
流程自動化、異常預警、視覺化管理，提升跨部門與跨據點效率。
完工後模型持續服務設備、維修、改建與資產管理，BIM 不再是一次性成果。

old: 模型多停留在設計或施工階段
文件、影像、設備分散管理
不同據點難以統一比較
neu: 設計到營運全生命週期
驗收資料直接延續到物業與營運
支援遠距、多點、跨國管理
建立上帝視角數據智控

pillars.d: No need to be on site — HQ sees the live status of every site, plant and building.
Sites across cities and countries, managed with one standard on one platform.
Equipment, energy, video and engineering data connected live — from monitoring to prediction and control.
Eyes (video), nerves (sensors), brain (AI) and hub (VBIM) — understand the whole building at a glance.
From global, site, building, floor and space down to each asset — everything on one screen.
Documents, drawings and site video recorded on-chain; AI agents act only within granted authority — traceable and revocable.

stages.d: Drawing cleanup, error checks, model collaboration, version and design review
Schedule, quality, safety, materials, video and the construction model in sync
Defects, re-inspection, asset handover, as-builts and e-sign-off
Equipment, maintenance, VMS, AIoT, energy and ESG in real time
Warranty, common areas, repairs, owners’ associations and building history

edge.d: BIM + PMIS + CCTV/VMS + AI + AIoT + digital twin — no more data scattered across tools.
E-signatures, full audit trails and on-chain records reduce disputes and distortion.
Automated workflows, early warnings and visual management across teams and sites.
The model keeps serving equipment, maintenance, renovation and asset management after handover.

old: Models stop at design or construction
Documents, video and equipment managed separately
neu: Full lifecycle from design to operations
BIM, PMIS, VMS and AIoT on one platform
Commissioning data flows into facility management
A god’s-eye view with data-driven control

family.d: The core platform for BIM, PMIS, digital twin, video, AIoT, energy and AI.
Beds, scheduling, space, medical equipment and campus operations.
POS, footfall, parking, tenants, video and equipment data in one view.
